meta.title: Hournook: Online booking software for appointment-based businesses
meta.description: Your own booking page, calendar, customer list and automatic reminders for salons, nail studios, barbers, clinics, trainers, consultants and every business that runs on appointments. {price}/month, {days}-day free trial, no card required.

hero.lead: Get your own booking page in minutes. Clients choose a service and a free time on their phone, and the appointment lands in your calendar. Confirmation and reminder emails are sent for you.
hero.srDescription: Animated example: customers book an appointment on a business’s Hournook booking page, then the business is notified and the customer receives a confirmation email. Examples rotate through a nail studio, barbershop, clinic, beauty salon, training studio and consultancy. All names are fictional.

faq.title: Good questions, straight answers.
faq.lead: Something else? <link>Visit support</link> or email us.

website.a: No. Your booking page is your website for bookings: a link like hournook.com/book/your-business that you can share on Instagram, Facebook, Google, WhatsApp or by text. If you already have a website, you can add the booking widget to it.

clients.a: They open your link on their phone or computer, pick a service and one of the times you are actually free, and enter their name, email and phone. No app and no account needed. They get a confirmation email straight away.

trial.q: What happens after the free trial?
trial.a: Nothing happens automatically. We never ask for a card up front. If Hournook works for you, subscribe for {price}/month to keep taking bookings. If not, your booking page simply stops accepting new bookings.

fees.q: Are there fees per booking or per team member?
fees.a: No. {price}/month per business includes unlimited bookings, your whole team and every feature. We never take a cut of what you charge.

cancel.q: Can clients cancel or move their appointment?
cancel.a: Yes, from the link in their confirmation email, but only within the limits you set (for example, not later than 24 hours before). You can also switch this off.

pay.a: Not at the moment. Clients pay you the way they do today, at the appointment. Hournook shows you the value of your completed appointments.

gdpr.q: Is my clients’ data safe and GDPR compliant?
gdpr.a: Yes. Data is encrypted in transit, each business is fully separated, and a GDPR data processing agreement is included for every account. You can export or erase a client’s data at any time.

setup.q: I’m not good with technology. Is it hard to set up?
setup.a: Setup takes a few minutes: name your business, add your services with their length and price, and set your opening hours. We suggest typical services for your type of business, and you can change everything later. If you get stuck, email us and a real person answers.

cta.title: Your booking page could be live in ten minutes.
cta.text: Start free for {days} days. No card, no contract. Just fewer messages and more bookings.
